{{Top|canon=Reythan Crackers and Moss Mousse|}}
'''Reythan crackers''' were crackers from [[Reytha]]. They were a type of food that had a smell that [[Larin Moxla]] did not like, although she did not know the reason why. The crackers were considered to be a very delicious and favorite food during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
